text:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT ALERT • severity=high • runtime-canary us-west-2 experiencing elevated latency and partial throughput degradation. paging @raj_oncall and @ops-rota. Link: https://internal.incidents/4932107777 :rotating_light:

raj_oncall: on it. saw rollout completed ~5m ago (release/2026-03-17/fast-path). suspected feature: batch_prefetch_v2 turned on in canary. grabbing logs and perf dash now.

oliver_sre: pinging infra — any auto-rollback?

incidents-bot: no auto-rollback triggered. Canary threshold alert at 2.5x tail latency.

raj_oncall: quick data: tail latency up from ~120ms -> 3.2s; p50 ~220ms -> 500ms. throughput (tokens/s) down ~25% across canary slice. errors up 0.8% -> 2.7% (client 5xx). Noted many kernel-fallback traces in logs.

emma_dev: logs snippet from one node:
```
2026-03-17T12:34:01Z runtime[pid=4221]: kernel fallback triggered on pod runtime-7f1
reason=kernel_oom_like prefetch_window=320ms batch_window=120ms
stack: kvcache_miss -> prefetch_backoff -> fallback_exec
```

maya_pm: customer impact? any big tenants hitting errors?

raj_oncall: preliminary query: ~3 enterprise customers with high QPS saw request latency spikes and a few retry storms. Support tickets: 2 P1s opened. I'll export list to #support-urgent.

oliver_sre: option A = flip kill-switch for batch_prefetch_v2 feature flag in canary, option B = rollback release/2026-03-17. Recommend kill-switch first (least disruptive).

emma_dev: agree. flag flip path:
```
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  https://ff.redwood.internal/api/toggle 
  -d '{"flag":"batch_prefetch_v2","env":"canary","state":false}'
```

raj_oncall: performing flag flip now. will hit /metrics and logs for regression.

ops-rota: FYI handoff in 10m to @oliver_sre (oncall rotation).

incidents-bot: ROUTE_UPDATE • oncall -> oliver_sre @ 4932108000

raj_oncall: flipped flag at 4932107895. immediate observation: initial latency tail dropping on 3/4 pods, throughput climbing back. still seeing kernel-fallback chatter on 1 pod (runtime-3c9).

oliver_sre: I'm on. pulling node-level telemetry. running drain + restart on runtime-3c9 to clear fallback state.

oliver_sre: restart command executed: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime --namespace=canary --pod=runtime-3c9`

raj_oncall: post-restart: runtime-3c9 kernel-fallback logs reduced, p95 latency for canary slice down to ~420ms, p50 ~230ms, throughput within 95% of baseline. errors back down to 0.9%.

maya_pm: notifying customer success + affected accounts. drafting message to 3 impacted customers, will coordinate with support.

emma_dev: putting a temporary post-deploy hold on rollout to prod. do not promote this release until root cause understood (batch window handling + prefetch backoff).

oliver_sre: adding follow-up runbook items: increase observability for prefetch window metrics, add auto-detect for kernel-fallback rate > 5/min to autoswitch flag.

raj_oncall: current plan: monitor for 15m. if stable, we close incident and leave rollout on hold. if regress to >2s tail or throughput drop >15% again, we will execute full rollback to previous release.

ops-rota: handoff complete to @oliver_sre. I'm available if needed. :white_check_mark:

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE • status=mitigated (partial) • mitigation=feature-flag-disabled + pod restart • assigned=oliver_sre • ticket=INC-2026-1298

oliver_sre: will keep monitoring dashboards. scheduling a quick RCA sync at +2h to dive into kernel fallback root cause and whether prefetch tuning or KERNEL scheduler changes required.

emma_dev: thanks team. please paste any follow-up logs/links here for the RCA.

raj_oncall: link to perf snapshot: https://dashboards.internal/shot/4932107777/perf. Closing loop with support in 30m.

oliver_sre: marking thread as stable for now. will reopen if anomalies reappear. :thumbsup:
